title: Search Dreamina (or use the direct official link https://t.c...
content:
Search Dreamina (or use the direct official link https://t.co/4gKN7jnLyU) and click Create now (top right) to enter the main workspace and start generating with Seedance 2.0  
Use the direct link to land on Dreamina’s main creation page immediately and skip extra navigation steps  
Select AI Video → Dreamina Seedance 2.0 → Omni Reference to start building your clip  
Use Dreamina Seedance 2.0 Omni Reference to select specific elements from a reference clip (e.g., transitions or action beats) so the model learns only those parts and recreates the style without copying the full clip  
Use Dreamina Seedance 2.0 Fast (free trial) to test/generate clips without paying upfront
description:
After months of waiting, Dreamina Seedance 2.0 is finally live on Dreamina.

👇 Here’s a quick step-by-step guide to use it for your social media clips:

• Look up “Dreamina” on Google, or use this direct link to the official site → https://t.co/4gKN7jnLyU
• Click “Create now” in the top right to enter Dreamina’s main workspace
• Using the direct link above will take you straight to the main creation page with no extra steps
• Log in with your preferred account method
• Choose “AI Video - Dreamina Seedance 2.0 - Omni Reference” to start building your clip
Quick note before you jump in — the official final name is now Dreamina Seedance 2.0.

Early access is already live on Dreamina, so you can skip the waitlist entirely and get started right away.

What’s also great is that Dreamina Seedance 2.0 Fast is currently available for free trial, so you can try it without any pressure.

It’s also already making waves — recently ranking #1 in both T2V and I2V leaderboards on Artificial Analysis.

The standout feature for social creators is the ability to reference and extract specific elements: trending transitions, viral action beats, you name it. The AI will only learn the exact parts you select, so you can recreate any popular content style in one click, without copying the full clip.

I tested this with a trending reel style, and generated a really polished, on-trend video sequence from one simple prompt with Dreamina Seedance 2.0.

If you’re always chasing trending formats but don’t have time to manually recreate every edit, this tool fits perfectly into your workflow. It’s simple, consistent, and helps you turn around on-trend clips faster. Check it out for your next post!

ja.title: Dreaminaを検索する（または公式リンク https://t.co/4gKN7jnLyU を直接使用する）し、右上の
ja.content:
Dreaminaを検索する（または公式リンク https://t.co/4gKN7jnLyU を直接使用する）し、右上の「Create now」をクリックしてメインワークスペースに入り、Seedance 2.0での生成を開始します。  
直接リンクを使用してDreaminaのメイン作成ページにすぐにアクセスし、余分なナビゲーションステップをスキップします。  
AI Video → Dreamina Seedance 2.0 → Omni Referenceを選択して、クリップの作成を開始します。  
Dreamina Seedance 2.0 Omni Referenceを使用して、参照クリップから特定の要素（例：トランジションやアクションビート）を選択し、モデルがそれらの部分のみを学習してスタイルを再現し、クリップ全体をコピーしないようにします。  
Dreamina Seedance 2.0 Fast（無料トライアル）を使用して、事前に支払うことなくクリップをテスト/生成します。  
---

使用 Dreamina Seedance 2.0 Fast（免费试用）测试/生成剪辑，无需提前付款
